item.title: LBH Instrument Bridge (0.1.0)
item.description:
Version: 0.1.0
Author: The Minstrel
Category: LotRO Tools & Utilities for Users
Updated: 2026-07-19 20:15 UTC
Downloads: 309
File: LBH-InstrumentBridge_v0.1.0.zip (2.3 KB)

LBH Instrument Bridge is a lightweight LOTRO plugin built to work with the upcoming Larthys Band Helper desktop app.

The LBHInstrumentBridge is entirely optional for the user to install. When loaded on a character it reads the instrument currently equipped in LOTRO and saves that information to the characters local PluginData file. Larthys Band Helper checks that file in the background and uses it to recognise the characters real instrument state.

Put simply this means Band Helper does not have to assume an instrument swap worked. If the wrong instrument is equipped the app can...

item.description:

Author: Vinny
Category: LotRO Tools & Utilities for Users
Updated: 2026-04-22 18:45 UTC
Downloads: 34,290
File: RuneUse_1.0.zip (38.9 KB)

RuneUse is a tool for managing runes and determining how to best enhance traceries. It will tell you which runes can be used now which will require a reforge and at what level and which runes are too low for you to use. With multiple characters it will recommend which character can best use a rune and if they can use it now

Notes: This is a beta release but it is fully functional and verified. If you find a defect please report it and Ill work on fixing it. The latest version of VinnyLoader already supports loading this plugin.

/ru list ...

item.description:

Author: Anglachel
Category: LotRO Tools & Utilities for Users
Updated: 2026-01-25 11:52 UTC
Downloads: 13,532
File: IstelienL_v0.94.zip (5.7 MB)

Overview

Istelien L for LOTRO is a multilanguage quiz engine with an advanced automation for answer validation and game flow allowing the host to play with others in equal conditions or to be only a game master. It also includes several quiz packages including more than 4000 questions from J.R.R. Tolkiens main books.
Quiz games using Istelien L will happen exclusively through the LOTROs integrated chat in the selected chat channel. Players dont need any special implement; ony the game host needs the plugin.

Category: LotRO Tools & Utilities for Users
Updated: 2025-05-13 13:14 UTC
Downloads: 3,241
File: Mosby-1.2.zip (259.5 KB)

This is a simple plugin that lets you select up to 4 FMs or WMs for creeps and those are added to a small quickslot window. Clicking on one of those icons sends a message to your fellowship if youre in a fellowship or raid that shows the colorcoded FM.

The intent is to help you coordinate which FM to do. It should be quite helpful for the Draigoch raid for example.

Suggestions comments and any feedback is welcome

Plugin Compendium should automatically update it.
